changeLog: 1.7.2 | 2026-03-28 | UI redesign: Replaced threats blocked card with live active system processes monitored count, added Protected since strip below safety tips, fixed notification bell red dot stuck on (missing generic `.hidden` CSS), removed non-functional history chevrons/hover, fixed browse/add buttons showing as dots. Bug fixes: B26 Pause Protection no longer triggers UAC or fails (removed `sc.exe interrogate` gate, pure IPC now, 15min auto-resume is safety net). NSIS installer version synced to 1.7.2. Performance: WMI events now processed through bounded `Channel<T>` with `SemaphoreSlim(4)` instead of unbounded `Task.Run`. `EnumWindows` reuses static collections to reduce GC pressure. `ThreatDatabase.GetBlockedExeStems()` pre-computes scanner stems. Reliability: TamperProtection retries 3×500ms before firing `ExecutableLocked` (prevents AV false positives). Log rotation protected by cross-process named mutex. IPC timeout is now per-command (30s panic, 20s kill-all, 10s default).
